presets.name: 1.28R-240x240-
presets.header:
/* 1.28R 240x240 圆屏 (GC9A01) 布局导出 — lcd-layout-studio */
#include "bsp_gc9a01.h"

templates.RGB888: LCD_drawImage({x}, {y}, {w}, {h}, {pic}, 0xFFFF);   /* RGB888(R,G,B)宏 已编译期压为 RGB565 */

presets.name: 1.2-128x128
presets.header:
/* 1.2 128x128 方屏 (ST7735S, +32 偏移由 LCD_Address_Set 内部处理) 布局导出 */
#include "bsp_st7735s.h"

templates.RGB888: LCD_drawImage({x}, {y}, {w}, {h}, {pic}, 0xFFFF);   /* RGB888(R,G,B)宏 已编译期压为 RGB565 */
templates.GRAY: LCD_drawGrayImage({x}, {y}, {w}, {h}, {pic}, {color}, {mirror});   /* 8bit灰度×颜色, {colorName}; 参考 GC9A01 实现 */
